tasks.label: Event remit and responsibilities
tasks.basis: Untimed researcher planning allowance, not a supplier quote, staffing promise, rate or time observation.
tasks.counting_note: Agree purpose, actual organiser/venue responsibilities and intended output.

tasks.label: Venue, privacy and access assessment
tasks.basis: Untimed researcher planning allowance, not a supplier quote, staffing promise, rate or time observation.
tasks.counting_note: Review feasible capacity, access, conversation privacy, layout and proportionate arrangements.

tasks.label: Supplier scope and terms coordination
tasks.basis: Untimed researcher planning allowance, not a supplier quote, staffing promise, rate or time observation.
tasks.counting_note: Review actual availability, charge bases, guaranteed covers, payment and cancellation terms.

tasks.label: Participant pool and suitability map
tasks.basis: Untimed researcher planning allowance, not a supplier quote, staffing promise, rate or time observation.
tasks.counting_note: Identify a relevant pool. Public contacts are not recruited or permissioned participants.

tasks.label: Individual invitation attempt
tasks.basis: Untimed researcher planning allowance, not a supplier quote, staffing promise, rate or time observation.
tasks.counting_note: One actual individual approach or follow-up, including an unsuccessful attempt. No conversion assumed.

tasks.label: Participant suitability and permissions
tasks.basis: Untimed researcher planning allowance, not a supplier quote, staffing promise, rate or time observation.
tasks.counting_note: Relevant fit, employer hospitality acceptability and participation/use choices. Not consent to unrelated marketing.

tasks.label: Confirmed-person logistics
tasks.basis: Untimed researcher planning allowance, not a supplier quote, staffing promise, rate or time observation.
tasks.counting_note: One ordinary scheduling and practical-information cycle, not every message.

tasks.label: Access or dietary coordination case
tasks.basis: Untimed researcher planning allowance, not a supplier quote, staffing promise, rate or time observation.
tasks.counting_note: Only necessary additional handling beyond ordinary logistics. Keep sensitive detail out of this model.

tasks.label: Material attendance or date change
tasks.basis: Untimed researcher planning allowance, not a supplier quote, staffing promise, rate or time observation.
tasks.counting_note: Actual extra handling, including withdrawals/replacements; do not derive from a guessed no-show rate.

tasks.label: Moderator topic and process preparation
tasks.basis: Untimed researcher planning allowance, not a supplier quote, staffing promise, rate or time observation.
tasks.counting_note: Use existing permitted research; agree neutral process, boundaries and participation. New research belongs in its production task.

tasks.label: Moderator live delivery
tasks.basis: Untimed researcher planning allowance, not a supplier quote, staffing promise, rate or time observation.
tasks.counting_note: Actual required live person-hours, including each genuine co-moderator. Do not multiply every preparation task by every role.

tasks.label: Moderator debrief and necessary actions
tasks.basis: Untimed researcher planning allowance, not a supplier quote, staffing promise, rate or time observation.
tasks.counting_note: Bounded agreed actions and handover, excluding separate research writing or supplier reconciliation.

tasks.label: Host preparation and guest liaison
tasks.basis: Untimed researcher planning allowance, not a supplier quote, staffing promise, rate or time observation.
tasks.counting_note: Actual host tasks not already performed in coordination or moderator preparation.

tasks.label: Host live work
tasks.basis: Untimed researcher planning allowance, not a supplier quote, staffing promise, rate or time observation.
tasks.counting_note: Actual hosting person-hours; if the same person moderates, do not count simultaneous elapsed work twice.

tasks.label: Onsite setup, liaison and close
tasks.basis: Untimed researcher planning allowance, not a supplier quote, staffing promise, rate or time observation.
tasks.counting_note: Total additional person-hours across actual workers. Includes proportionate venue/emergency liaison, not duplicate live role hours.

tasks.label: Permitted live note-taking
tasks.basis: Untimed researcher planning allowance, not a supplier quote, staffing promise, rate or time observation.
tasks.counting_note: Optional and permission-dependent. No recording or transcription service is assumed.

tasks.label: Agreed event synthesis and review
tasks.basis: Untimed researcher planning allowance, not a supplier quote, staffing promise, rate or time observation.
tasks.counting_note: Only a selected separate output. Map to existing report/cycle-note work when the same output serves both.

tasks.label: Release and participant follow-through
tasks.basis: Untimed researcher planning allowance, not a supplier quote, staffing promise, rate or time observation.
tasks.counting_note: One actual permitted batch and ordinary follow-through. Do not duplicate WS12 distribution or WS20 cycle-note work.

tasks.label: Supplier reconciliation and closure
tasks.basis: Untimed researcher planning allowance, not a supplier quote, staffing promise, rate or time observation.
tasks.counting_note: Check final supplier bill, credits and open actions. Distinct from customer invoice/receipt work.

tasks.label: Travel arrangements
tasks.basis: Untimed researcher planning allowance, not a supplier quote, staffing promise, rate or time observation.
tasks.counting_note: One actual journey/accommodation arrangement; shared booking only once, genuine extra handling separately.

tasks.label: Additional staff travel time
tasks.basis: Untimed researcher planning allowance, not a supplier quote, staffing promise, rate or time observation.
tasks.counting_note: Only time not already counted as productive work or included elsewhere. Actual paid/cash/resource treatment remains to be chosen.

tasks.label: Unallocated incurred or exception work
tasks.basis: Untimed researcher planning allowance, not a supplier quote, staffing promise, rate or time observation.
tasks.counting_note: Use only for identifiable necessary work not already in the rows above. Cancellation does not erase incurred work. Never add the same preparation twice.

external_cost_rows.label: Venue and catering
external_cost_rows.scope_note: Actual eligible consumption, minimum shortfall, hire and applicable charges, after a venue-specific reconciliation.

external_cost_rows.label: External facilitation or hosting
external_cost_rows.scope_note: Only an actually selected package. Record prep, live work, notes, travel and tax inclusions before combining with labour costs.

external_cost_rows.label: Rail, air or other fares
external_cost_rows.scope_note: Route/date/traveller-specific booking amount, restrictions and payer. Do not infer a fare from a promotional minimum.

external_cost_rows.label: Accommodation
external_cost_rows.scope_note: Necessary rooms/nights, actual rate and cancellation terms. No city or overnight stay is assumed.

external_cost_rows.label: Local transfers or mileage reimbursement
external_cost_rows.scope_note: Actual approved basis and eligible journeys; no automatic HMRC-rate reimbursement.

external_cost_rows.label: Access or support provision
external_cost_rows.scope_note: Only actual necessary provision, after clarifying responsibilities and arrangements.

external_cost_rows.label: Participant expenses or honoraria
external_cost_rows.scope_note: Only if actually agreed and permitted. Free attendance creates no reimbursement or incentive promise.

external_cost_rows.label: Materials or equipment
external_cost_rows.scope_note: Necessary items not supplied by the venue or included in an existing package.

external_cost_rows.label: Platform or registration tools
external_cost_rows.scope_note: Select only needed functionality. A free-ticket platform option does not price internal handling.

external_cost_rows.label: Insurance or specialist advice
external_cost_rows.scope_note: Only where applicable to the actual organiser/venue arrangements. No invented compulsory premium.

external_cost_rows.label: Change or cancellation loss
external_cost_rows.scope_note: Net nonrecoverable cost under actual terms, excluding deposits already included in the supplier final total.

external_cost_rows.label: Other scoped direct cost
external_cost_rows.scope_note: Identify the item, period, payer and nonoverlap basis before using.

integration_requirements: Match event to selected programme, city, date and edition; do not infer recurring cadence.
Carry incurred work and future obligations across the correct periods.
Reconcile package scope and hours to avoid double cash/resource valuation.
Keep cash payment, resource use, full supplier bill and refundable/credited deposit distinct.
Use original currencies and dated FX before combining cross-country amounts.
Use actual applicable task skill/rate; do not copy a research or sales proxy to moderation.
Show staff travel time separately from fare cash and productive work.
Preserve report-free practitioner benefits, permissions and no implied guaranteed attendance.
